source: TSTD / ADB TA 7305-CAM technical manual, "សណ្តែកត្រើង (សណ្តែកកួរ)" [Yard-long bean cultivation manual]
text: Harvest guidance emphasizes frequent, regular picking (the manual describes harvesting every 1–2 days during peak production) to keep pods at the tender, marketable stage — pods left too long on the vine become fibrous and less desirable, and also signal the plant to slow new flower/pod production, so prompt harvest both improves individual pod quality and sustains the plant's overall yield over its multi-week harvest window.
